message:
Fix patch email not sending (DB timing + missing column)

- email_opt_in column was never added to live DB (only in CREATE TABLE
  IF NOT EXISTS which no-ops on existing tables). Added ALTER TABLE
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS migration.
- sendPatchEmailToUsers was called before initDB() finished, so
  app_config table and email_opt_in column didn't exist yet. Now
  queued in pendingPatchEmail and fired in initDB() finally block
  after all migrations complete.

Also in this push:
- Hangman text game: mandatory 150-word bank (no more fake words)
- Hangman HTML template added (mandatory, like TTT)
- regenNavStep: games in regen variants now render as game cards
- maybeRenderGame: guard empty gameHtml, origin-check on game_over

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>

patch_email.subject: Lily here — games just got way better 💜
patch_email.headline: New games update!
patch_email.subheadline: Hangman actually works now. You're welcome.
patch_email.body:
Heyyyy~ It's Lily! 💜

Okay sooo I have to tell you — we fixed Hangman. Like, for real this time. It was picking made-up words before (so embarrassing), and now it has a whole list of real ones. Also the whole game is prettier now with an actual gallows drawing and everything.

Oh and Tic-Tac-Toe got some sneaky fixes too so it plays nicer. Games in general are just... better now!

Come try it out — I dare you to beat me at Hangman~ 🎮
